about.purpose: CV term-PLACEMENT conformance via the PSI CvMapping model (mzPeak port). Where cv.rules.json's cv_inflection checks that each accession is known and resolves, these rules check that the RIGHT terms appear in the RIGHT facet, with the required combination logic (AND/OR/XOR), child-term inheritance (allow_children) and cardinality (is_repeatable). See docs/cv-mapping-design.md.
about.applies_to: the packed facets of spectra_metadata / chromatograms_metadata; imaging rule gated on is_imaging.
about.how_to_amend: The rule CONTENT lives in the bundled CvMapping files under cv_mapping/ (the spec's own table_rules.json, byte-for-byte). To change which terms are required where, edit those files (or the spec). The engine rules below only bind a mapping file to its mzPeak facet paths (params.path_map) and set the severity ceiling for MUST. 'about'/'doc'/'fix' are documentation; the engine reads id/primitive/severity/recovery/params/fix.

primitives.cv_mapping: params: mapping_file (bundled CvMapping path), path_map (scope_path -> {file,facet}), [require_imaging]. The engine injects the parsed mapping (_mapping) and the OBO is_a graph (_cv_isa). For each CvMappingRule: MUST -> finding at this rule's severity, SHOULD -> warning, MAY -> skipped (Phase 1). A term is satisfied by an accession that equals it (use_term) or is its is_a descendant (allow_children); non-repeatable terms matched by >1 column are flagged. Unmapped scope_paths and absent files/facets are skipped.

rules.doc: CV term placement for the spectra_metadata / chromatograms_metadata facets, from the spec's cv_mapping/table_rules.json. Shipped at WARNING in Phase 1 (advisory, non-regressing): some spec MUSTs were written against mzML's element model and do not yet map cleanly to mzPeak's packed facets (e.g. spectrum type wants a child of MS:1000559; scan 'spectra combination' MS:1000570 is not represented). Promote to error per-rule once the spec/converter reconcile (one-line severity change). data_arrays[] and products[] scopes are intentionally unmapped (Phase 2).
rules.fix: Declare the required CV term in the named facet (as an inflected ${CV}_${ACC}_${name} column). For 'spectrum type', use a concrete child of MS:1000559 (e.g. MS:1000294 mass spectrum), not the abstract parent.

_unmapped_phase2: /spectrum/scan_list*, /spectrum/precursors[]/activation, /spectrum/precursors[]/isolation_window, /spectrum/{products,data_arrays}[], /chromatogram* : mzPeak's packed facets do not surface these as inflected columns today (spectra combination, scan-window limits, activation, isolation, binary-data terms); mapping awaits spec/converter confirmation. Add a path_map entry to enable.

rules.doc: Imaging-profile CV placement (cv_mapping/imaging_table_rules.json), gated on is_imaging: an imaging scan facet MUST carry promoted pixel coordinates IMS:1000050 (position x) AND IMS:1000051 (position y). The mzPeak analogue of the mzML MALDI object rules; complements imaging_coordinates_1based (which checks the coordinate VALUES once the columns exist).
rules.fix: Promote the pixel coordinates into the scan facet as scan.IMS_1000050_position_x and scan.IMS_1000051_position_y.
